title: Unit – 4 : Session – 2 : SLO – 2  |  Built-in Higher-Order Functions (map, reduce, filter)
sections: 1. The filter() function in Python returns an object that contains elements from the iterable that satisfy a condition (predicate function).
2. A function is pure if it does not have side effects and does not change any external (global) state.
1. list(map(lambda x: x + 1, [1, 2, 3])) → [2, 3, 4] — map applies the lambda to each element, adding 1 to each.
reduce: functools.reduce(lambda a, b: a * b, [1, 2, 3, 4]) → 24 (factorial of 4).
